title: Herengracht 256
description: A narrow historic canal house photographed straight-on from across the Herengracht: three bays of tall sash windows on an east-facing facade, flanked by taller neighbours and a row of canal trees.

title: 21bis Boulevard Diderot
description: A Haussmann-era corner apartment block opposite Gare de Lyon: a south-facing stone facade with continuous wrought-iron balconies, a brasserie at street level and a zinc mansard roof.

title: 106 Ridge Street
description: A 1914 Colonial Revival tenement on the corner of Ridge and Rivington Streets on the Lower East Side: six storeys of brick and fire escapes on a narrow Manhattan street grid, photographed from across the intersection.

title: Obala Kulina bana 24
description: The neo-Moorish former police station on the Miljacka embankment, photographed square-on from the opposite bank in full afternoon sun: a yellow stucco facade with horseshoe-arched windows, a row of round attic windows and a crenellated centre bay. OSM maps it as three building=apartments footprints; whether it is lived in today is not confirmed.
